newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi Aramco cuts March propane, butane prices.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco cuts March propane, butane prices.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's state-owned oil firm Saudi Aramco said on Wednesday that it had cut its propane contract price for March by $50 from the previous month to $270 per tonne, and its price for butane by $28 to $277 per tonne.
The propane price for March is $70 higher than the same month a year ago, while the price of butane is $89 higher than last year.
The Saudi contract price is loosely based on the results of three monthly spot tenders and the company's own assessment of spot market trends.
